horizon: before any GP-225 GNN training launch
objective_resolver: Resolve from future v19.19 mixed-density replay artifact metrics.
question: Will a GP-225 mixed-density replay run generated from v19.15 pass a bounded replay gate without false accepts and without unblocking GNN training?
success_threshold: rows_attempted between 80 and 140 AND clean_replay_rows>=72 AND selected_true_false_accepts=0 AND all_post_quarantine_false_accepts=0 AND no_rescue_density>=0.45 AND source_packets>=4 AND top_areas>=8 AND training_now=false AND gnn_blocked=true
void_conditions: infra failure, resolver unavailable, or contract artifact missing
